ns0:r.ns0:t: The CR is solely based on the justification of aligning test signalling value with network deployment value. RAN5 does allow such alignment on a case by case basis provided the proposed value is conformant to the core specifications as well it is a common deployment value, i.e. agreeable to all interested Carriers active in RAN5. Concerns about proposed change deviating from RAN4 core requirements have been raised in the responses to the RAN5 Chair, which were not fully convincing. From one of the responses received, it was advised the proposed value is not agreeable to a Carrier who has interest in B41 HP UE. This Carrier would like to see more discussions in RAN5 before reaching an agreement.
